outcome: Expression of proteins involved in mitochondrial biogenesis (PGC-1a, SIRT1)
Mitochondrial protein quality and genome stability
cohort: Placental villous tissue was collected from term pregnancies of lean, obese, or obese with type A2 gestational diabetes women following elective cesarean section.
finding: Maternal obesity and gestational diabetes distinctly affect placental mitochondria through complex, often fetal sex-specific, mechanisms, leading to altered mitochondrial function and impaired quality control and clearance.
